label: PF Backlog 609
title: Concurrent sessions: uniquely-name scratch/temp files (avoid shared temp-dir collision)
body:
## Problem / why
During BI-PF-1318 delivery, two concurrent agent sessions shared `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Temp\opencode` and one
OVERWROTE the other's `resolve_merge.py`, so the wrong script ran (pointing at another session's worktree). Any
session that writes a fixed-name scratch file in a shared temp dir can clobber a peer's - silent, hard to trace.

## Goal & value
Concurrent sessions never collide on scratch files.

## In scope
- Guideline/rule: scratch/temp files (scripts, logs, dumps) must be UNIQUELY named per session
  (e.g. include the session/pid/ULID), or written under a session-scoped directory.
- Optionally: a tiny helper for session-scoped scratch paths.

## Out of scope
- The OS temp location itself.

## Acceptance criteria
- The worker charter / AGENTS note "unique scratch filenames per session".
- A helper (if built) returns a session-scoped path; test covers uniqueness.

## Rollback
Remove the guidance/helper.

## Related
IS-PF-0036 (one working tree per session), BI-PF-0462 (id collisions). Epic BI-PF-1248.
